typecheck.scope: candidate-form.tsx and candidate-form-contract.ts plus required transitive types only

original_defect: Valid CandidateFields unmounted on invalid scope/choices before its notification effect could clear the parent editable draft. Parent could retain its last valid onChange payload.
changes: Outer unconditional hooks compute valid basis or null; layout effect notifies onChange(null) on initial/changed basis including invalid scope and choices
Current render basis and host lock gate all child onChange/onSubmit callbacks; retained earlier callback cannot emit an old payload after scope loss/change or locking
Child initial effect removed to avoid duplicate invalidation
Malformed non-array choice families return invalid instead of throwing before the invalidation path
current_draft_clear_boundary: Only onChange(null) for parent editable draft. Parent must retain prepared command, UNKNOWN mode/key/full payload/readset and saved receipt independently. No cancellation/restore/transport callback is present.
manual_source_assessment: All hooks run before early returns
Valid scope to null/invalid scope reaches outer invalidation
Valid choices to duplicate/malformed choices reaches outer invalidation
Valid scope to another valid scope resets local fields and notifies once
Callback identity changes alone do not repeatedly clear unchanged valid draft
Stale callbacks denied by live basis and locked gate
